name: R1 Lite
summary:
R1 Lite is a Galaxea Dynamics dual-arm mobile manipulation platform in the R1 humanoid family. It combines an articulated upper body with a wheeled base, supporting manipulation research, data collection and task development.

The official family specification distinguishes arm, torso and chassis configurations for R1, R1 Pro and R1 Lite. Teleoperation and onboard computing support experimentation with embodied AI. Measurements in this record are tied to the named model and configuration; specifications for an individual A1 arm are not treated as those of the complete robot.
